entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Diana, my ID is 401. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about an order. I have this VeloBand Pulse monitor and I... I need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Um, let me see. Yes, it's VF-8675309.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 12 days ago, on December 22nd. So I can best help, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... a lot. All the settings and the app, it's all a bit much for me. I think I made a mistake. Can't you just help me? I'd like to return it.

I understand. I'm looking at our policy for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, and because it's a personal device that activates to a user's account, it has a strict 10-day return window. It looks like we're currently on day 12.
Ten days? Oh, I had no idea. The website was so confusing. I... I honestly didn't even take it out of the plastic until yesterday. We had a really serious family emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Of course, family always comes first. We do have exception policies for extenuating circumstances. Would you be comfortable sharing what happened?

My husband... he had to have an emergency surgery last week. He was in the hospital for days. Between that and his upcoming military deployment, everything has just been a complete blur. This return was the last thing on my mind.

Thank you for sharing that with me. I sincerely hope your husband is recovering well. That sounds incredibly stressful, and we certainly don't expect you to be worrying about a return during a medical emergency like that.

Given the situation with the hospital stay and the impending deployment, I am absolutely able to make a one-time exception for you. I can process this as a full refund back to your original payment method. Would that be okay?
Oh, really? You can do that? That's... that is such a weight off my shoulders. Thank you so much.

Of course. It's the least we can do. I've just processed the return authorization. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just place the device back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
That's wonderful. Thank you again, Diana. You've been a tremendous help.
It was my pleasure. I wish your husband a swift recovery. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
